column1: # The pictures of older eras' files whose materials are worked out from the pictures themselves
# (relief.py --into <era> --stands-for this table), because no material made from end of retail's
# pictures matches them (docs/ERAS.md in Pyreal). One line each, tab-separated:
# era, the picture, the end-of-retail picture it stands for, why (moved: Throne of Destiny gave
# its surfaces that other picture; repainted: the picture under the same id is other art; room: a
# picture the era's rooms draw that no material covered in any era; ground: a ground picture no
# material covers), and whether it takes that picture's recipe (recipe), is shaped by the recipe
# it looks to want (classify), or is ground shaped by the named recipe (ground:<recipe>). Facts
# about ids alone, worked out by the era survey from the player's own files. Era eor is end of
# retail's own ground pictures that no surveyed material covers (the survey sees what models
# draw, not the land): each stands for itself. The older eras lay end of retail's ground, so
# they have none of their own.
